## Administrative roles

- Vice-Dean for accreditation, internationalisation and annual reporting, Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Bucharest (since 2020), and member of the Faculty Council.
- Scientific Director of NIRDBS (2021–2022).
- Director of project 2PFE/2021 on strengthening the research capacity of NIRDBS (2021–2024).
- Member of the organising committees of several scientific events (see [Projects](projects.qmd#organisation-of-scientific-events)).
